questions.title: 人际关系技能｜Q001
questions.subject: PMP
questions.domain: 利益相关方与沟通管理

stemParts.text: 一位项目经理被指派管理一个正在执行中的数百万美元项目。在一次项目状态会议上，一名团队成员提到由于一位高级管理人员未回应沟通，导致部分任务出现延迟。项目经理应采取什么措施?

options.text: 建立流程，每日向该高级管理人员发送提醒
将该任务从关键路径中移除，以避免影响项目进度
利用人际网络联系该高级管理人员以获得回应
将该问题升级上报给该高级管理人员的上级

questions.analysis: ①本题核心考点为“管理沟通”与“干系人参与”中的软技能应用。面对高级管理人员（高管）不回复的情况，项目经理应首先利用人际关系技能解决问题，而非直接上报或机械提醒。②A项“每日提醒”属于骚扰式沟通，可能引起高管反感，是不专业的做法；B项“移出关键路径”掩盖了延迟事实，属于欺骗性行为，无法解决问题；D项“直接升级上报”跳过了与高管的直接沟通，属于打破组织政治层级的激进做法，通常在直接沟通无效后才使用。③C项“利用人际网络联系高管”属于《PMBOK指南》定义的“人际关系技能”（如建立信任、通过非正式渠道解决问题）和“管理沟通”中的推荐做法，既体现了解决问题的主动性，又维护了对高管的尊重，是当前场景下的最佳措施。

en.title: PMP Question 001: Interpersonal Skills

stemParts.text: A project manager has been assigned to a multimillion-dollar project already in execution. During a project status meeting, one of the team members mentions that there are some delays because a senior executive is not responding to communications. What should the project manager do?

options.text: Establish a process to send daily reminders to the senior executive.
Remove the task from the critical path so it will not affect the project schedule.
Use networking to contact the senior executive to get a response.
Escalate the concern to the senior executive's manager.

en.analysis: This question tests Interpersonal Skills. When a stakeholder is not responding, first use interpersonal and networking skills to establish direct contact before escalating. Therefore option C is the best answer. A: Incorrect. Daily reminders are repetitive communication and do not solve the access problem. B: Incorrect. Moving work off the critical path hides the schedule impact instead of solving it. C: Correct. Networking is an interpersonal technique that can establish contact without premature escalation. D: Incorrect. Escalation is heavier-handed and should follow reasonable direct/contact attempts.

optionFeedback.A: Incorrect. Daily reminders are repetitive communication and do not solve the access problem.

optionFeedback.C: Correct. Networking is an interpersonal technique that can establish contact without premature escalation.
optionFeedback.D: Incorrect. Escalation is heavier-handed and should follow reasonable direct/contact attempts.

questions.title: 教练与指导、培训｜Q002
questions.subject: PMP

stemParts.text: 一位项目经理观察到某位团队成员在当前项目中变得日益缺乏投入。项目经理应采取什么措施以确保该团队成员积极参与？

options.text: 与该团队成员沟通，了解问题，并要求其采取纠正措施
指派另一位团队成员担任该成员的导师
召开团队会议，讨论团队参与的期望
要求该成员接受额外培训以提升沟通技巧

questions.analysis: ① 核心考点：针对团队成员绩效或投入度下降的问题，项目经理应首先展现服务型领导力，直接与当事人沟通以了解根本原因（一对一沟通），而非盲目采取集体行动或间接手段。② 逐项分析：B项（安排导师）和D项（额外培训）均属于未做诊断就先给出了假设性解决方案（Mentoring通常用于绩效好需提升，Training通常用于能力不足），不够直接；C项（召开团队会议）未指名道姓，无法解决个体隐性问题，且可能制造尴尬。③ A项最优：直接沟通是解决此类问题的首选步骤，体现了尊重和解决问题的主动性，识别出问题后再协商纠正措施。

en.title: PMP Question 002: Coaching, Mentoring, and Training

stemParts.text: A project manager observed that a team member is becoming increasingly disengaged from an ongoing project. What should the project manager do to help ensure participation from this team member?

options.text: Speak to the team member, understand theproblem, and ask the team member to work on corrective actions.
Ask another team member to mentor the disengaged team member.
Call a team meeting to discuss team engagement expectations.
Ask the team member to undergoadditional training to improve their communication skills.

en.analysis: This question tests Coaching, Mentoring, and Training. For an individual engagement problem, speak directly with the person to understand the cause before prescribing a solution. Therefore option A is the best answer. A: Correct. Direct conversation identifies the cause and enables an appropriate corrective action. B: Incorrect. Mentoring presumes a development need before the disengagement cause is known. C: Incorrect. A team-wide meeting is disproportionate for an individual issue and may create embarrassment. D: Incorrect. Extra training assumes a communication-skill problem that has not been diagnosed.

optionFeedback.B: Incorrect. Mentoring presumes a development need before the disengagement cause is known.
optionFeedback.C: Incorrect. A team-wide meeting is disproportionate for an individual issue and may create embarrassment.

questions.title: 自组织团队｜Q003
questions.subject: PMP

stemParts.text: 某团队最近采用了敏捷方法，并正在遵循Scrum模型。在一次迭代中，首席开发人员与质量保证成员之间在工作方法上发生了冲突，影响了当前冲刺的目标。项目经理应如何解决这一冲突?

options.text: 与每个团队成员分别单独召开会议，并建议他们自行解决冲突
分析情况，并帮助团队成员了解冲突的影响
协助团队成员协作并共同解决问题
在回顾会议中讨论该情况，并创建行动项

questions.analysis: 本题核心考点为敏捷环境中团队冲突的处理原则。敏捷强调团队自组织和协作，ScrumMaster（或项目经理）在团队面临内部冲突时，应首先扮演教练的角色，促进团队成员之间的沟通与协作，鼓励他们自己解决问题，而不是简单地回避或由管理者直接解决。选项A建议单独会谈并让他们自行解决，虽体现了自组织，但“单独会谈”切断了沟通，不如C选项直接促进协作有效。选项B虽然分析了影响，但没有推进解决动作。选项D将问题留待回顾会议，时间跨度过大，无法缓解对当前Sprint目标的影响。因此，C选项“协助团队成员协作并共同解决问题”是最积极且符合敏捷理念的干预方式。

en.title: PMP Question 003: Self-Managing Team

stemParts.text: A team has recently adopted agile and is following a scrum model. There is a conflict between a lead developer and a quality assurance team member regarding their approaches, which is impacting the sprint goals. What should the project manager do to resolve these conflicts?

options.text: Call separate meetings with each team member and suggest that the team members resolve it at their level.
Analyze the situation and help the team members understand the impact of the conflict.
Help the team members collaborate and resolve their problem together.
Discuss the situation in the retrospective session and create an action item.

en.analysis: This question tests Self-Managing Team. In agile, facilitate collaboration so team members resolve conflict together rather than separating or delaying the discussion. Therefore option C is the best answer. A: Incorrect. Separate meetings reduce direct collaboration and leave the conflict unresolved between the parties. B: Incorrect. Understanding impact alone does not facilitate resolution. C: Correct. Joint collaboration supports self-management and resolves the conflict at team level. D: Incorrect. Waiting for the retrospective delays action while the current sprint goal is affected.

optionFeedback.A: Incorrect. Separate meetings reduce direct collaboration and leave the conflict unresolved between the parties.
optionFeedback.B: Incorrect. Understanding impact alone does not facilitate resolution.
optionFeedback.C: Correct. Joint collaboration supports self-management and resolves the conflict at team level.
optionFeedback.D: Incorrect. Waiting for the retrospective delays action while the current sprint goal is affected.

keyPath.label: Self-Managing Team
keyPath.ruleText: In agile, facilitate collaboration so team members resolve conflict together rather than separating or delaying the discussion.

questions.title: 以价值为导向进行决策｜Q004
questions.subject: PMP
questions.domain: 项目管理方法论与生命周期
questions.topic: 以价值为导向进行决策

stemParts.text: 一项创新项目正在利用人工智能(AI)识别化学化合物以开发新产品，AI处理阶段的持续时间可能从三天到两周不等且结果无法预测，项目需在固定的两个月时间内交付至少一个产品规格并遵守严格预算，目标是优化预算使用并交付尽可能高的商业价值。项目经理应采取什么行动？

options.text: 确保规格迭代限制在整个项目期间的50%
确保AI处理限制在整个项目预算的25%
在AI处理之后直接规划一次迭代，以分析并优先排序开发目标
将规格工作规划为具有固定持续时间的预测性任务，以保证价值

questions.analysis: 本题考查在不确定性环境下的价值交付。项目采用AI且结果不可预测，属于适应性生命周期，应遵循敏捷原则聚焦价值。选项A和B用固定百分比限制迭代和预算，属于僵化的预测思维，无法应对AI结果的不确定性；选项D试图用固定任务保证价值，忽略了创新的不可预测性。选项C通过在AI处理（探索）后立即安排迭代进行分析和优先级排序，确保基于最新结果调整后续工作，从而在固定预算下将资源集中在最有价值的目标上，体现了敏捷的‘拥抱变化’和‘最大化价值’原则。

en.title: PMP Question 004: Value-Based Decision Making

stemParts.text: An innovative project is leveraging artificial intelligence (Al) to identify chemical compounds for the development of new products. The Al processing phase can vary in duration, ranging from three days to two weeks, and the outcomes are unpredictable. The project's primary objective is to deliver at least one product specification within a fixed two-month timeframe while adhering to a strict budget that cannot be increased. What action should the project manager take to optimize the use of the fixed budget and deliver the highest possible business value?

options.text: Ensure that the specification iterations are limited to 50% of the overall project duration.
Ensure that the Al processing is limited to 25% of the overall project budget.
Plan an iteration directly after Al processing to analyze and prioritize the development goals.
Plan the specification work as a predictive task with a fixed duration to guarantee value.

en.analysis: This question tests Value-Based Decision Making. Under high uncertainty and fixed constraints, reassess and prioritize after new information becomes available to maximize value. Therefore option C is the best answer. A: Incorrect. A fixed 50% time allocation is arbitrary and does not respond to uncertain AI outcomes. B: Incorrect. A fixed 25% budget cap is arbitrary and may block the highest-value path. C: Correct. Reassessing and prioritizing immediately after AI results uses current information to maximize value. D: Incorrect. Predictive fixed-duration work cannot guarantee value under highly uncertain discovery.

optionFeedback.A: Incorrect. A fixed 50% time allocation is arbitrary and does not respond to uncertain AI outcomes.
optionFeedback.B: Incorrect. A fixed 25% budget cap is arbitrary and may block the highest-value path.
optionFeedback.C: Correct. Reassessing and prioritizing immediately after AI results uses current information to maximize value.
optionFeedback.D: Incorrect. Predictive fixed-duration work cannot guarantee value under highly uncertain discovery.

questions.title: 变更流程｜Q005
questions.subject: PMP

stemParts.text: 在实施过程中，项目共同发起人(为项目贡献了大量资金)通知项目团队要为交付物增加一个新特性，项目经理应该怎么做?

options.text: 评估新需求的影响并更新风险登记册
按计划完成当前项目，稍后再根据新需求进行更新
收集共同发起人的需求并执行集成变更控制过程
说服共同发起人维持当前范围并按计划完成项目

questions.analysis: 本题考查整体变更控制流程。核心矛盾在于：项目中途即使是重要发起人提出增加新功能，也属于范围变更，必须走正式流程，不能私下接受或直接拒绝。A选项只评估风险和更新登记册是局部的分析动作，不足以覆盖变更流程的全部要求（如审批、更新基准）；B选项违反了“未批准的变更不予执行”原则，易导致范围蔓延或镀金；D选项直接拒绝重要干系人的需求属于消极应对，未运用管理技能（如谈判、影响）来处理需求；C选项体现了正确的处理逻辑：先收集详细需求，然后通过“实施整体变更控制”流程来评估、审批和更新，这是处理所有变更的标准做法。

en.title: PMP Question 005: Change Control Process

stemParts.text: Halfway through implementation, the project co-sponsor, who is contributing a significant amount of capital to the project, informs the project team of an additional feature to the project deliverable. What should the project manager do?

options.text: Assess the impact of the new requirement and update the risk register.
Complete the current project as planned and update it later with the new requirements.
Collect the co-sponsor's requirements and perform the integrated change control process.
Convince the co-sponsor to maintain the current scope and complete the project as planned.

en.analysis: This question tests Change Control Process. A new feature is a change request; collect the requirement and follow integrated change control before implementation. Therefore option C is the best answer. A: Incorrect. Impact assessment is useful but updating only the risk register is not the complete change process. B: Incorrect. Deferring the request without formal evaluation ignores an active scope-change request. C: Correct. Collecting the requirement and using integrated change control follows formal governance. D: Incorrect. Rejecting the request outright bypasses evaluation and stakeholder management.

optionFeedback.B: Incorrect. Deferring the request without formal evaluation ignores an active scope-change request.
optionFeedback.C: Correct. Collecting the requirement and using integrated change control follows formal governance.
optionFeedback.D: Incorrect. Rejecting the request outright bypasses evaluation and stakeholder management.

questions.title: 估算持续时间｜Q006
questions.subject: PMP

stemParts.text: 项目经理正在规划一个复杂的项目，该项目必须在约定的预算内交付高质量的产品。项目干系人急于看到产品发布，并对团队施加压力，要求尽快交付产品。项目经理必须确定项目的估计持续时间并处理干系人的期望。项目经理应该如何确定一个现实的项目持续时间估算?

options.text: 确认干系人的交付期望
估算每个项目任务的持续时间
分析行业基准和标准
告诉团队制定详细的发布计划

questions.analysis: 本题考查进度管理中的“制定进度计划”流程，核心在于确定项目持续时间的科学方法。①核心矛盾：面对复杂项目及干系人压力，如何得出“现实”的工期（非妥协或空想）。②逐项分析：A（确认期望）是沟通管理，用于了解需求但无法产出技术上的“估算”数据；C（行业基准）是类比估算的参考，但在“复杂项目”中通常精度不足；D（发布计划）属于输出结果，必须基于已有的工期数据，不能反推。③正确选项：B（估算任务持续时间）是制定进度计划的基础步骤（PMBOK定义活动后估算持续时间），唯有通过自下而上估算各项任务，结合资源与逻辑关系，才能得出客观、现实的项目总时长。故选B。

en.title: PMP Question 006: Estimate Activity Durations

stemParts.text: 在一个正在进行的敏捷施工项目中，项目经理收到通知称，当地政府最近批准了适用于该地区所有建筑项目的更严格的可持续性法规。这些新法规将影响项目在材料和可持续性相关流程方面的实施。项目经理应首先采取什么措施以适应这些新实施的环境参数?

options.text: 与产品负责人会面，更新项目计划以纳入新的可持续性要求
组织一次团队研讨会，以识别并评估满足新可持续性要求的解决方案
按照原计划继续推进项目，并与干系人会面，说明新法规并征求他们的反馈
向项目客户请求延期，以便有更多时间满足新的要求

questions.analysis:
1. 核心考点：敏捷环境下的“响应变化”。题目背景是外部法规（EEF）变更，符合敏捷原则“欢迎需求变化，即使到开发后期”。
2. 排除B：在敏捷中，未确定范围前直接组织技术团队研讨是浪费，应先由PO确认需求。
3. 排除C：新法规是强制性的合规要求，必须采纳，不能仅“描述”和“反馈”，且不能无视变更继续原计划。
4. 排除D：先评估影响再谈工期，直接请求延期为时过早。
5. 正确A：合规性变更是必须遵守的。PO负责最大化产品价值及管理待办列表。PM首先应与PO沟通，将新法规作为约束条件转化为新的用户故事（需求）并调整Product Backlog（即更新计划），这是敏捷响应变更的标准流程。

en.title: PMP Question 011: Welcome Changing Requirements

stemParts.text: In the midst of an ongoing agile construction project, the project manager receives notification that the local government has recently approved stricter sustainability legislation applying to all construction projects in the region. These new regulations will have an impact on the project's materials and processes related to sustainability. What should the project manager do first to adapt to these newly instituted environmental parameters?

options.text: Meet with the product owner to update the project plan to incorporate the new sustainability requirements.
Organize a team workshop to identify and evaluate solutions for meeting the new sustainability requirements.
Continue the project as planned and meet with stakeholders to describe the new regulations and solicit their feedback.
Request a timeline extension from the project client to allow for additional time needed to meet the new requirements.

en.analysis: This question tests Welcome Changing Requirements. Mandatory regulatory change must be incorporated into agile planning through the product owner before continuing unchanged or requesting relief. Therefore option A is the best answer. A: Correct. 1.  **核心矛盾**：外部法规的约束（截止日期、巨额罚款）直接威胁项目可行性。在项目启动阶段，面对强制性制约因素，项目经理的首要职责不是盲目执行或寻找技术解决方案，而是评估项目的生存能力和合规性。

options.text: 评估包括该任务的可行性和影响，并在适当的情况下将其纳入未来的迭代

questions.analysis:
本题核心考点为沟通问题的解决步骤与优先级。发现干系人报告不准确且掌握错误信息时，说明当前沟通存在障碍或理解偏差。首先应遵循“先分析原因、再解决问题”的原则，直接与当事人沟通以澄清信息并纠正行为，这是最直接且有效的干预措施。

B项：安排会议面对面沟通，既能直接纠正信息偏差，又能维护关系，符合“管理与监督沟通”中通过互动解决信息误差的最佳实践。

stemParts.text: 一个项目是为了在公司设立一个新的业务职能而进行的。项目完成几个月后，项目经理仍在处理项目的业务运营，同时还在进行另一个项目。项目经理在项目开始时应该做些什么，以防止这种情况发生?

options.text: 确保组织结构的修订是一个交付成果
在项目关闭过程中将过渡计划作为一个交付成果
在项目开始时与项目赞助人澄清RACI图表
确保招聘过程被纳入项目管理计划

questions.analysis:
本题核心考查项目收尾阶段中的“运营与运维转移”流程。项目经理在项目收尾时，必须确保项目成果（新产品、新职能）已平稳过渡给运营团队或职能部门，从而释放项目资源。项目经理在收尾后仍处理运营工作，说明缺失了过渡计划。
A项组织结构修订通常是项目范围的一部分，但不是防止“运营纠缠”的直接手段；
C项RACI图表虽明确了职责，但若没有具体的过渡执行计划，仅靠RACI无法确保运营团队的接收；
D项招聘过程属于资源获取，无法解决移交后的权责归属问题。
B项“过渡计划”是收尾过程的关键交付物，明确规定了知识转移、所有权移交及责任转换，确保项目结束后业务由运营部门接手，是防止项目经理陷入运维的直接措施。

en.title: PMP Question 049: Scrum Events

stemParts.text: A developer has completed the deliverable for a feature. The product owner is not sure how to assess the quality of the deliverable. Considering that the project is using an agile approach, what kind of tool or technique should the product owner use?

en.title: PMP Question 060: Performance Analysis Methods

stemParts.text: During a final inspection of a new product, the project team discovers a significant defect in one of the key deliverables. This defect poses a security risk to the client, who expects to start using the deliverable in two weeks. What should the project manager do?

options.text: Conduct a quality investigation and initiate corrective action.
Use the contingency reserve to cover the cost of the defect.
Meet with the client to explain the cause of the defect.
Send the client a letter apologizing for the inconvenience.

en.analysis: This question tests Performance Analysis Methods. A significant security-related defect requires immediate quality investigation and corrective action before cost or apology discussions. Therefore option A is the best answer. A: Correct. Investigate the serious defect and initiate corrective action because client security is at risk. B: Incorrect. Funding the defect repair before investigating cause and action is premature. C: Incorrect. Explaining the cause to the client does not first remove the security risk. D: Incorrect. An apology alone does not correct the dangerous deliverable.

optionFeedback.A: Correct. Investigate the serious defect and initiate corrective action because client security is at risk.
optionFeedback.B: Incorrect. Funding the defect repair before investigating cause and action is premature.
optionFeedback.C: Incorrect. Explaining the cause to the client does not first remove the security risk.
optionFeedback.D: Incorrect. An apology alone does not correct the dangerous deliverable.
